projects.title: Deep Learning-Based Multimodal Fatigue Detection
content: Objective: Developed a modular research pipeline for fatigue detection using facial video and EEG-derived fatigue signals.
Extracted visual indicators including blink dynamics, eye-closure patterns, facial movement, head pose, expression changes, and subtle temporal facial cues.
Generated frame-level embeddings with pretrained vision models and converted them into sequence-level representations using temporal windows, pooling, attention, LSTMs, and transformer-based models.
Compared pretrained embeddings, handcrafted visual indicators, and temporal sequence-modeling approaches.
Used EEG-derived fatigue measures for weak supervision, cross-modal validation, and interpretation of video-based predictions.
Implemented reusable preprocessing, augmentation, feature extraction, training, validation, and performance-evaluation workflows.
Evaluated classification performance, stability, generalization, signal reliability, and robustness across visual-only and multimodal modeling strategies.

projects.title: AI-Powered Job Application Automation Platform
content: Designed and developed an end-to-end workflow for collecting, evaluating, tailoring, and tracking software and machine learning job applications.
Integrated job scraping with structured extraction and normalization to create a searchable job database.
Used LLMs to analyze job descriptions, identify required skills, estimate relevance, and generate tailored resumes and cover letters from a master CV.
Organized job metadata, document versions, and application status in Airtable while preserving a manual review step before submission.
Architecture: Built modular n8n workflows with reusable subworkflows, configurable prompts, error handling, and support for multiple data sources.
Designed the platform for future semantic matching, embeddings, additional job boards, and AI-assisted application prioritization.

projects.title: Grading Assistant Application

\textbf{Architecture:} Separated screen monitoring, region selection, rubric handling, AI analysis, overlay UI, settings, and export logic into reusable modules.
Designed the workflow to support multiple rubrics and grading contexts while keeping final grading decisions under human control.
Focused on usability, workflow speed, feedback consistency, and clear separation between model suggestions and instructor decisions.

projects.title: Drug Response Prediction from Gene Expression and Molecular Features
content: Built deep learning models for patient-specific drug sensitivity prediction.
Integrated gene-expression data with molecular structure and SMILES-derived drug representations.
Preprocessed and merged multimodal biomedical datasets while validating sample, drug identifier, and feature consistency.
Developed neural architectures for predicting drug response from patient and drug features.
Tuned model parameters, explored feature selection, and analyzed model outputs for interpretable biomedical patterns.

projects.title: Structured Sparsity for Cancer Genomics
content: Explored regularized neural networks and structured sparsity methods for identifying active biological pathways, genomic signatures, and network-level patterns associated with prognosis or treatment response.
Studied Group Lasso, Graphical Lasso, LassoNet, and Elastic Net, and investigated theoretical extensions of Lasso-regularized neural networks for multimodal data integration.

Developed concepts for sparse, interpretable representations across multiple data modalities, including biologically structured feature selection, missing modality handling, and structured information sharing between modality-specific network blocks.
Investigated the use of multi-omic datasets such as TCGA and CPTAC to improve interpretability and predictive performance in high-dimensional biomedical machine learning.
Contributed to research planning and proposal development for biologically structured and interpretable machine learning models.

projects.title: Single-Cell Trajectory Inference and RNA Velocity Review
content: Studied trajectory inference methods for single-cell RNA sequencing, including pseudotime, RNA velocity, spliced and unspliced RNA dynamics, and cluster-level pathway alignment.
Compared Dyno, Waddington-OT, CSHMM, PAGA, and Tempora and examined limitations caused by topology assumptions.
Presented work on velocity-based methods in single-cell RNA sequencing.
Considered PCA-based gene weighting and correlation-based cell similarity as interpretable approaches for dimensionality reduction and trajectory analysis.

projects.title: Predicting High School Student Performance
content: Compared linear regression, Ridge, Lasso, Elastic Net, principal component regression, regression trees, random forests, and neural networks.

Evaluated homoscedasticity, normality, multicollinearity, predictive accuracy, and interpretability.
Identified stable predictors including previous grades, absences, family relationships, failures, guardian status, and employment-related variables.

projects.title: Clinical Data Analysis Using Generalized Linear Models
